items.name: ouro-base
items.title: Ouro base
items.description: Installed with every component; you don't need to add it. What every Ouro UI component needs in the app's CSS: success and warning colors, a destructive foreground, the motion tokens, the press utility, the keyframes for spinners, progress bars and skeletons, and --ouro-layer, the z-index of sheets and dialogs (50; raise it in a :root rule of your own if your app has fixed bars above z-50).
items.docs: Ouro UI's base tokens are in your CSS. Your theme's values win: edit them like any shadcn variable.

@utility press.transition: scale var(--ouro-spring-duration) var(--ouro-ease-spring), background-color var(--ouro-duration-fast) ease-out, border-color var(--ouro-duration-fast) ease-out, color var(--ouro-duration-fast) ease-out, opacity var(--ouro-duration-fast) ease-out

items.name: ouro-theme
items.title: Ouro theme
items.description: Ouro UI's own look, as a shadcn theme for :root and .dark. Skip it to keep your app's theme.
items.docs: The Ouro theme replaced your theme's colors in :root and .dark. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs

items.name: ouro-lib
items.title: Ouro lib
items.description: Installed with every component; you don't need to add it. Shared helpers every Ouro UI component uses, in lib/ouro: cn, dev messages, the className check, announce, toast, OuroProvider and hooks.
items.docs: Ouro UI's helpers are in lib/ouro. OuroProvider is optional; it routes internal hrefs through your router's link. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs

items.name: ouro-testing
items.title: Ouro testing
items.description: Installed with every -tests item; you don't need to add it. The test kit Ouro UI's tests use: Vitest browser projects with the drag, flick, tap, touchDrag and emulateMedia commands, the act helper, axeExclude, and the end-to-end story helper.

items.description: Optional: the Vitest browser tests for ouro-lib, with the test tooling as devDependencies. Add it beside ouro-lib: add ouro-lib ouro-lib-tests.
